update.releaseNotes:
v5.8.0 - In-app auto updater
Features --- - Check for updates on launch and from the drawer (cloud icon) - Download and install APK updates directly from GitHub releases - Version checks use versionCode from update.xml for reliable comparisons - Changelog viewer uses the same release notes feed
Fixes --- - Update feed now points to Staticwitt/uma-android-automation (was steve1316)
